_comment: Alert thresholds for the disposable deployment_rehearsal product (scripts/rehearsal/product.toml). Same shape as deploy/alerts/thresholds.json: the foundation catalogue (dotmac_deployment_foundation.alerts.COMMON_ALERTS) supplies a default for every foundation-shaped placeholder; every name below is a product-threshold placeholder with no default, so `dotmac-deploy render` refuses without it (see alerts.py's module docstring, 'Placeholders'). Values here are deliberately short-fused for a rehearsal that runs minutes, not the real Starter's production values in deploy/alerts/thresholds.json.
